records.arabic: الهدلي له إدراك قال كنا نقوم في المسجد في عهد عمر رواه عنه مسلم بن جندب أخرجه البخاري في كتاب خلق أفعال العباد
records.english: al-Hadalī. He lived into the Islamic period. He said: “We used to stand in the mosque during ʿUmar’s time.” Muslim ibn Jundab related this from him, and al-Bukhārī transmitted it in Khalq Afʿāl al-ʿIbād.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تقدم في بشير بن يزيد
records.english: He appeared above under Bashīr ibn Yazīd.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
له إدراك وشهد اليمامة وقال في ذلك
تدور رحانا حول راية عامر
يرانا بالأبطح المتلاحق
يلوذ بنا ركنا معد ويتقي
بنا غمرات الموت أهل المشارق ونزل البصرة بعد ذلك ذكره المرزباني
records.english:
He lived into the Islamic period. He also witnessed al-Yamāmah. He said concerning it:

“Our millstone turned around the banner of ʿĀmir;
he saw us upon the closely joined plain.
The two pillars of Maʿadd sought shelter with us,
and through us the people of the east warded off the surges of death.”

He later settled in Basra. Al-Marzubānī mentioned him.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
الأسدي ذكره وثيمة في كتاب الردة فيمن ثبت على إسلامه هو وابنه زفر وكان من أشراف بني أسد فالتحق بخالد بن الوليد قال وأرسل إلى بني أسد يحذرهم بأبيات منها
بني أسد ما في طليحة خصلة
يطاع بها يا قوم في حي فقعس
records.english:
al-Asadī. Wathīmah mentioned him in the Book of the Apostasy among those who remained steadfast in Islam, together with his son Zufar. He was one of the nobles of Banū Asad and joined Khālid ibn al-Walīd. Wathīmah said that he sent verses to Banū Asad warning them, including:

“Banū Asad, Ṭulayḥah has no quality
for which he should be obeyed, O people, among the clan of Faqʿas.”

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تقدم في الحارث بن عوف
records.english: He appeared above under al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAwf.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
اليماني ذكر وثيمة في كتاب الردة أنه كان ممن قال في قتل الأسود العنسي بأمر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وفي ذلك يقول بعد قتل الأسود
لعمرك انا يوم عبدان عصبة
يمانية الأحساب غير لئام
غداة جدعنا في عنيس بضربة
أبان بها المكشوح رأس همام
records.english:
al-Yamānī. Wathīmah mentioned in the Book of the Apostasy that he was among those who took part in killing al-Aswad al-ʿAnsī at the command of the Prophet ﷺ. After al-Aswad was killed, he said concerning it:

“By your life, on the day of ʿAbdān we were a band
Yemeni in lineage, not base,
on the morning when, at ʿUnays, with a single blow we lopped off
the head of Hammām, which al-Makshūḥ severed.”

records.arabic: الأسلمي قال بن يونس شهد هو وأخوه فتح مصر
records.english: al-Aslamī. Ibn Yūnus said that he and his brother witnessed the conquest of Egypt.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: التجيبي العامري ذكر بن يونس أنه شهد فتح مصر وولى غزو البحر وهو صاحب المسجد الذي في زقاق الطحاوي بالمصوصة
records.english: al-Tujībī al-ʿĀmirī. Ibn Yūnus mentioned that he witnessed the conquest of Egypt and was appointed to command a naval expedition. The mosque in al-Maṣūṣah, in the alley of al-Ṭaḥāwī, was associated with him.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن طارق التيمي الكوفي الفقيه والد إبراهيم سكن الكوفة روى عن عمر وعلي وأبو ذر وابن مسعود وحذيفة وغيرهم روى عنه ابنه إبراهيم وإبراهيم النخعي وجواب التيمي والحكم بن عيينة وآخرون قال بن سعد كان عريف قومه وقال أبو موسى يقال أدرك الجاهلية
records.english: son of Ṭāriq. He was al-Taymī, the Kufan jurist and father of Ibrāhīm. He settled in Kufa and related from ʿUmar, ʿAlī, Abū Dharr, Ibn Masʿūd, Ḥudhayfah, and others. His son Ibrāhīm, Ibrāhīm al-Nakhaʿī, Jawwāb al-Taymī, al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUyaynah, and others related from him. Ibn Saʿd said that he was the headman of his people. Abū Mūsā said that he is reported to have lived during the pre-Islamic period.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
الأسدي تقدم في الشماخ وأنه المعروف بمزرد أبو ضرار ويقال أبو الحسن أخو الشماخ وكان الأسن قال المرزباني أدرك الإسلام فأسلم وقال في قصيدته التي أولها
صحا القلب عن سلمى وقل العواذل
ويقول فيها
وقد علموا في سالف الدهر أنني
معن إذا جد الجراء وهازل
زعيم لمن قاذفته بأوابد
يغنى بها الساري وتحدى الرواحل
فمن ترمه منها ببيت يلح به
كشامة وجه ليس للشام غاسل
records.english:
al-Asadī. He appeared earlier in the biography of al-Shammākh, where it was stated that he was known as Muzarrid, Abū Ḍirār, and also Abū al-Ḥasan. He was al-Shammākh’s elder brother. Al-Marzubānī said that he lived to see Islam and embraced it. In his ode that begins:

“The heart has recovered from Salmā, and the reproachers have grown few,”

he also says:

“They knew in ages past that I
am earnest when the contest grows earnest, and playful when it is play.
I guarantee that whoever I assail with rare verses
will hear the night traveler sing them and the riding beasts be urged on by them.
Whoever among them is struck by one verse finds it cling to him,
like a mole upon a face that no washer can remove.”

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
الأصرم بن شعبة بن هزم بن رويبة بن عبد الله بن هلال العامري ثم الهلالي يلتقي مع ميمونة أم المؤمنين في الهزم وهو بضم الهاء بعدها زاي له إدراك ولابنه عبد الله بن يزيد ذكر في زمن بني مروان ووفد حفيده عاصم بن عبد الله بن يزيد على أسد بن عبد الله القسري بخراسان فحبسه فقال
حباك خليلك القسري قبرا
لبئس على الصداقة ما حباكا في أبيات ذكره بن الكلبي سكن حمص
records.english:
al-Aṣram, son of Shuʿbah. His lineage continued through Hazm ibn Ruwaybah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Hilāl al-ʿĀmirī, then al-Hilālī. His lineage meets that of Maymūnah, Mother of the Believers, at Hazm—with ḍammah on the hāʾ followed by zāy. He lived into the Islamic period. His son ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd is mentioned during the time of Banū Marwān. His grandson ʿĀṣim ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd came in a delegation to Asad ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Qasrī in Khurasan, who imprisoned him. He said:

“Your friend al-Qasrī has bestowed upon you a grave;
wretched indeed is what he bestowed in friendship.”

This is part of verses mentioned by Ibn al-Kalbī. He settled in Homs.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بتحتانية الشاعر يعرف بالأخوص بالخاء المعجمة ذكره المرزباني في معجم الشعراء وقال انه مخضرم وله مع عيينة بن مرداس المعروف بابن فسوة الشاعر قصة وسماه أبو بشر الآمدي زيدا
records.english: With the letter yāʾ. He was the poet known as al-Akhwaṣ, with a dotted khāʾ. Al-Marzubānī mentioned him in Muʿjam al-Shuʿarāʾ and said that he lived across both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. He had an episode with the poet ʿUyaynah ibn Mirdās, known as Ibn Faswah. Abū Bishr al-Āmidī named him Zayd.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الزبيدي ويقال الكندي ويقال الكلبي سكن حمص قال بن سميع أدرك الجاهلية وقال بن سعد لقي أبا بكر وعمر وصحب معاذ بن جبل وروى عن معاذ وابن مسعود وغيرهما روى عنه أبو إدريس الخولاني وعطية بن قيس وأبو قلابة ومعبد الجهني ذكره بن سميع فيمن أدرك الجاهلية من أصحاب معاذ وقال العجلي من كبار التابعين وقال أبو مسهر كان رأس أصحاب معاذ مالك بن هبيرة وكان يزيد بن عميرة من رءوسهم
records.english: al-Zubaydī. He is also called al-Kindī and al-Kalbī. He settled in Homs. Ibn Sumayʿ said that he lived during the pre-Islamic period. Ibn Saʿd said that he met Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, accompanied Muʿādh ibn Jabal, and related from Muʿādh, Ibn Masʿūd, and others. Abū Idrīs al-Khawlānī, ʿAṭiyyah ibn Qays, Abū Qilābah, and Maʿbad al-Juhanī related from him. Ibn Sumayʿ listed him among the companions of Muʿādh who had lived during the pre-Islamic period. Al-ʿIjlī said that he was one of the senior Successors. Abū Mushir said that Mālik ibn Hubayrah was the leading companion of Muʿādh and that Yazīd ibn ʿUmayrah was among their leaders.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
بن مسعود بن كعب بن علوى بن عليان بن أرحب بن عامر بن مالك بن معاوية بن صعب بن دومان بن بكيل بن جشم بن خيران بن نوف بن همدان الهمداني ثم الأرحبي له إدراك وكان رئيسا كبيرا فيهم قال مجالد بن سعيد لما سار سعيد بن العاص حين كان أمير الكوفة لعثمان فثار عليه أهل الكوفة فتوجه إلى عثمان فاجتمع قراء الكوفة فأمروا عليهم يزيد بن قيس هذا ثم كان مع علي في حروبه وولاه شرطته ثم ولاه بعد ذلك أصبهان والري وهمدان وإياه عني القائل بعد ذلك يخاطب معاوية من أبيات
معاوى ان لا تسرع السير نحونا
فبايع عليا أو يزيد اليمانيا قال بن الكلبي اسم هذا الذي قال الشعر ثمامة
records.english:
son of Masʿūd. His lineage continued through Kaʿb ibn ʿAlwī ibn ʿAlyān ibn Arḥab ibn ʿĀmir ibn Mālik ibn Muʿāwiyah ibn Ṣaʿb ibn Dūmān ibn Bakīl ibn Jusham ibn Khayrān ibn Nawf ibn Hamdān al-Hamdānī, then al-Arḥabī. He lived into the Islamic period and was a great leader among them. Mujālid ibn Saʿīd said that when Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ, then ʿUthmān’s governor of Kufa, marched out and the people of Kufa rose against him, he headed to ʿUthmān. The Qurʾān reciters of Kufa then assembled and appointed this Yazīd ibn Qays over them. He later stood with ʿAlī in his wars. ʿAlī appointed him over his police, then later appointed him over Isfahan, Rayy, and Hamadhan. He is the man intended by the poet who later addressed Muʿāwiyah in these verses:

“Muʿāwiyah, if you do not hasten your march toward us,
then pledge allegiance to ʿAlī—or to Yazīd the Yemeni.”

Ibn al-Kalbī said that the man who composed this poem was named Thumāmah.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن قيس بن عبد الله بن معاوية بن الشيطان بن بكر بن عوف بن النخع النخعي له إدراك وكان ولده عبد الله بن يزيد من أصحاب علي ومات بالكوفة فصلى عليه علي ذكره هشام بن الكلبي
records.english: son of Qays. His lineage continued through ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muʿāwiyah ibn al-Shayṭān ibn Bakr ibn ʿAwf ibn al-Nakhaʿ al-Nakhaʿī. He lived into the Islamic period. His son ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd was among ʿAlī’s companions. He died in Kufa, and ʿAlī led the funeral prayer over him. Hishām ibn al-Kalbī mentioned him.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

title.arabic: يزيد بن قيس بن عبد الله
title.english: Yazīd ibn Qays ibn ʿAbd Allāh

records.arabic: البهزي له إدراك قال بن يونس شهد فتح مصر وذكروه في كتبهم
records.english: al-Bahzī. He lived into the Islamic period. Ibn Yūnus said that he witnessed the conquest of Egypt, and they mentioned him in their books.

records.arabic: من بني مالك بن سعد ذكر سيف في الفتوح أن عكرمة بعثه في كندة لما فرق أصحابه فيهم أيام الردة وذكره الطبري واستدركه بن فتحون والله أعلم
records.english: of Banū Mālik ibn Saʿd. The duplicated ibn is present in the source; whether it is dittography or replaces a lost name is unresolved. Sayf mentioned in al-Futūḥ that, during the apostasy wars, ʿIkrimah sent him among Kindah when he dispersed his companions among them. Al-Ṭabarī mentioned him, and Ibn Fatḥūn added him. والله أعلم

records.arabic:
بن يزيد بن الصعق وهو لقب واسمه عمرو بن الحارث بن خويلد بن نوفل بن عمرو بن كلاب بن ربيعة الكلابي وقيل ان الصعق لقب خويلد ذكر المزرباني جده يزيد بن الصعق وأنشد له هجوا في بني تميم وأنه كان في زمن النعمان بن المنذر وأما يزيد بن قيس فكنيته أبو المختار ذكره أيضا المرزباني في معجم الشعراء وذكر أنه نظم قصيدة يشكو العمال بالبصرة قالوا إلى عمر فأجابه عنها خالد بن غلاب وذكرها المدائني عن علي بن حماد وسحيم بن حفص وغيرهما قالوا قال أبو المختار يزيد بن قيس بن الصعق كلمة رفع فيها على عمال الأهواز وغيرهم إلى عمر بن الخطاب وهي
أبلغ أمير المؤمنين رسالة
فأنت أمين الله في النهي والأمر
وأنت أمين الله فينا ومن يكن
أمينا لرب العرش يسلم له صدري
فلا تدعن أهل الرساتيق والقرى
يسيغون مال الله في الأدم الوفر
فأرسل إلى الحجاج فاعرف حسابه
وأرسل إلى جزء وأرسل إلى بشر
ولا تنسين النافعين كلاهما
ولا بن غلاب من سراة بني نصر
وما عاصم منها بصغر عناية
وذاك الذي في السوق مولى بني بدر
وأرسل إلى النعمان فاعرف حسابه
وصهر بني غزوان اني لذو خبر
وشبلا فسله المال وابن محرش
فقد كان في أهل الرساتيق ذا ذكر
فقاسمهم نفسي فداؤك انهم
سيرضون ان قاسمتهم منك بالشطر
ولا تدعوني للشهادة انني
أغيب ولكني أرى عجب الدهر
نؤوب إذا آبوا ونغزو إذا غزوا
فان لهم وفرا ولسنا ذوي وفر اقتصر المزرباني على بعضها وزاد في آخرها البيت الثالث
إذا التاجر الهندي جاء بفأرة
من المسك راحت في مفارقهم تجري قال فقاسم عمر هؤلاء القوم فأخذ شطر أموالهم حتى أخذ نعلا وترك نعلا وكان فيهم أبو بكرة فقال اني لم آل لك شيئا فقال أخوك على بيت المال وعشور الأبلة فهو يعطيك المال تتجر به فأخذ منه عشرة آلاف ويقال قاسمه فأخذ شطر ماله قال والحجاج الذي ذكره هو بن عتيك الثقفي وكان على الفرات وجزء بن معاوية عم الأحنف وكان على سرف وبشر بن المحبوب كان على جندي سابور والنافعان أبو بكر نفيع ونافع بن الحارث بن خلدة أخوه وابن غلاب خالد بن الحارث من بني دهمان بن نصر بن معاوية بن بكر بن هوازن كان على بيت المال بأصبهان وعاصم بن قيس بن الصلت كان على مناذر والذي على السوق سمرة بن جندب كان على سوق الأهواز والنعمان بن عدي بن نضلة ويقال نضيلة بن عبد العزى بن حرثان أحد بني عدي بن كعب كان على كور دجلة وهو الذي قال
من مبلغ الحسناء أن حليلها
الأبيات وصهر بني غزوان مجاشع بن سعد السلمي كانت عنده ابنة عتبة بن غزوان وكان على صدقات البصرة وشبل بن معبد البجلي الأحمسي كان على قبض المغانم وابن محرش أبو مريم الحنفي كان على رامهرمز وكان على جسر الفرات قال المرزباني فأجابه خالد بن غلاب
أبلغ أبا المختار عني رسالة
ولم أك ذا قربى إليك ولا صهر
وما كان مالي من ولاية خربة
فتجعلني ممن يؤلف في الشعر ومن هذه القصيدة
مقاديم في دار الحفاظ مطاعم
مطاعين يوم البؤس بالأسل السمر
وسابغة تنسى السنان فضولها
أكفكفها عني بأبيض ذي أثر
records.english:
son of Yazīd. His lineage continued through al-Ṣaʿiq—an epithet; his name was ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Khuwaylid ibn Nawfal ibn ʿAmr ibn Kilāb ibn Rabīʿah al-Kilābī. It is also said that al-Ṣaʿiq was Khuwaylid’s epithet. Al-Marzubānī mentioned his grandfather Yazīd ibn al-Ṣaʿiq, cited a lampoon by him against Banū Tamīm, and said that he lived in the time of al-Nuʿmān ibn al-Mundhir. As for Yazīd ibn Qays, his kunyah was Abū al-Mukhtār. Al-Marzubānī also mentioned him in Muʿjam al-Shuʿarāʾ and stated that he composed an ode complaining about the officials in Basra to ʿUmar. Khālid ibn Ghallāb answered him. Al-Madāʾinī related it from ʿAlī ibn Ḥammād, Suḥaym ibn Ḥafṣ, and others. They said that Abū al-Mukhtār Yazīd ibn Qays ibn al-Ṣaʿiq delivered a poem to ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb accusing the officials of al-Ahwāz and others. It was:

“Deliver a message to the Commander of the Believers,
for you are God’s trustee in prohibition and command.
You are God’s trustee over us; whoever is trustee
for the Lord of the Throne—my breast submits to him.
Do not leave the people of the districts and villages
to swallow God’s wealth amid abundant leather goods.
Send for al-Ḥajjāj and examine his accounts;
send for Juzʾ, and send for Bishr.
Do not forget the two men named Nāfiʿ,
nor Ibn Ghallāb, one of the nobles of Banū Naṣr.
ʿĀṣim is no small concern among them,
nor that man in the market, the client of Banū Badr.
Send for al-Nuʿmān and examine his accounts,
and the son-in-law of Banū Ghazwān, for I am well informed.
Ask Shibl about the money, and Ibn Muḥarrish too,
for he was well known among the people of the districts.
Divide their wealth with them—may my life ransom you—
for they will be content if you divide it by half.
Do not summon me to bear witness, for I shall be absent,
but I behold one of the age’s wonders:
we return when they return and raid when they raid,
yet they possess abundance while we possess none.”

Al-Marzubānī quoted only part of it and added at its end this further verse:

“When the Indian merchant arrives with a pod
of musk, it soon courses through the partings of their hair.”

He said that ʿUmar divided the property of these men, taking half their wealth, to the point that he took one sandal and left the other. Abū Bakrah was among them. He said, “I have not withheld anything from you.” ʿUmar replied, “Your brother controls the treasury and the tithes of al-Ubullah, and he gives you money with which to trade.” He took ten thousand from him. It is also said that he divided his property and took half his wealth. The al-Ḥajjāj mentioned in the poem was Ibn ʿAtīk al-Thaqafī, who governed the Euphrates. Juzʾ ibn Muʿāwiyah, al-Aḥnaf’s paternal uncle, governed Saraf. Bishr ibn al-Maḥbūb governed Jundaysābūr. The two men named Nāfiʿ were Abū Bakrah Nufayʿ and his brother Nāfiʿ ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Kaladah. Ibn Ghallāb was Khālid ibn al-Ḥārith, of Banū Dahmān ibn Naṣr ibn Muʿāwiyah ibn Bakr ibn Hawāzin, and governed the treasury at Isfahan. ʿĀṣim ibn Qays ibn al-Ṣalt governed Manādhir. The man in charge of the market was Samurah ibn Jundab, who governed the market of al-Ahwāz. Al-Nuʿmān ibn ʿAdī ibn Naḍlah—also called Nuḍaylah—ibn ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā ibn Ḥirthān, one of Banū ʿAdī ibn Kaʿb, governed the districts of the Tigris. He was the man who said:

“Who will convey to the beautiful woman that her husband . . .”

and the rest of the verses. The son-in-law of Banū Ghazwān was Mujāshiʿ ibn Saʿd al-Sulamī. He was married to a daughter of ʿUtbah ibn Ghazwān and governed the alms of Basra. Shibl ibn Maʿbad al-Bajalī al-Aḥmasī was responsible for receiving the spoils. Ibn Muḥarrish was Abū Maryam al-Ḥanafī. He governed Rāmhurmuz and was stationed at the bridge over the Euphrates. Al-Marzubānī said that Khālid ibn Ghallāb answered him:

“Convey a message from me to Abū al-Mukhtār,
though I was neither your kinsman nor your relation by marriage.
My wealth did not come from a ruinous office,
that you should make me one of those woven into verse.”

From the same ode are these lines:

“Foremost in the abode of honor, providers of food,
men who thrust on the day of hardship with brown spears;
an ample coat of mail whose folds make the spearpoint forgotten—
I ward it away from myself with a marked white blade.”

records.english: He is treated under Zayd ibn Muḥammad.

records.arabic: بن عبد ود بن أمد بن كعب الصائد بن شرحبيل بن عمرو بن جشم بن صائد الهمداني ثم الصائدي وكان ولده محمد من أصحاب بن حنيفة وشهد مع المختار بن أبي عبيدة مشاهده ذكر ذلك بن الكلبي
records.english: son of ʿAbd Wudd. His lineage continued through Amad ibn Kaʿb al-Ṣāʾid ibn Shuraḥbīl ibn ʿAmr ibn Jusham ibn Ṣāʾid al-Hamdānī, then al-Ṣāʾidī. His son Muḥammad was among the companions of Ibn al-Ḥanafiyyah and took part with al-Mukhtār ibn Abī ʿUbaydah in his battles. Ibn al-Kalbī mentioned this.

records.arabic:
بن عبيد بن رؤاس بن كلاب بن ربيعة بن عامر بن صعصعة الرؤاسي أبو داود الشاعر ذكره المرزباني وقال مخضرم وأنشد له من أبيات
تواصل أحيانا وتصرم تارة
وشر الأخلاء الخليل الممزج وذكره بن الكلبي فلم يزد على وصفه بالشاعر
records.english:
son of ʿUbayd. His lineage continued through Ruʾās ibn Kilāb ibn Rabīʿah ibn ʿĀmir ibn Ṣaʿṣaʿah al-Ruʾāsī, Abū Dāwūd the poet. Al-Marzubānī mentioned him and said that he lived across the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. He cited from his verses:

“At times she keeps the bond, and at times she severs it;
the worst intimate is the wavering friend.”

Ibn al-Kalbī also mentioned him but described him only as a poet.

records.arabic:
بن عوف بن عمير بن كلب العامري تقدم نسبه في ترجمة أخيه زهير ولهما إدراك واستشهدا جميعا بالقادسية ذكر ذلك بن الكلبي وذكر المرزباني في معجم الشعراء يزيد بن مغفل الكوفي وأنشد له قوله وهو يقاتل مع الحسين بن علي وقتل حينئذ
ان تنكروني فأنا بن المغفل
شاك لدى الهيجاء غير أعزل
وفي يميني نصف سيف معصل
أعلو به الفارس وسط القسطل فاما أن يكونا اثنين أو أحد القولين في مكان قتله خطأ
records.english:
son of ʿAwf. His lineage continued through ʿUmayr ibn Kalb al-ʿĀmirī. His lineage appeared earlier in the biography of his brother Zuhayr. Both lived into the Islamic period, and both were martyred at al-Qādisiyyah; Ibn al-Kalbī mentioned this. In Muʿjam al-Shuʿarāʾ, al-Marzubānī mentioned Yazīd ibn Mughafal al-Kūfī and cited the lines he recited while fighting alongside al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, when he was killed:

“If you do not know me, I am Ibn Mughafal,
armed amid battle, not left weaponless.
In my right hand is half of a jagged sword;
with it I rise above the horseman amid the dust.”

They must therefore be two men, or one of the two statements about where he was killed is erroneous.

records.arabic: المرادي أخو عبد الرحمن له إدراك قال بن يونس شهد فتح مصر
records.english: al-Murādī. He was the brother of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān. He lived into the Islamic period. Ibn Yūnus said that he witnessed the conquest of Egypt.

records.arabic: اللخمي من بني بحر بن سوادة كان شريف فيهم وله إدراك قال بن يونس شهد فتح مصر وله رواية عن أبي ذر وروى عنه يزيد بن عمرو المعافري
records.english: al-Lakhmī. He belonged to Banū Baḥr ibn Sawādah. He was a noble among them and lived into the Islamic period. Ibn Yūnus said that he witnessed the conquest of Egypt. He related from Abū Dharr, and Yazīd ibn ʿAmr al-Maʿāfirī related from him.

records.arabic: بن شجرة بن يزيد التجيبي ثم الأيدعاني له إدراك قال بن يونس شهد فتح مصر وكان من الفرسان المعدودين
records.english: son of Shajarah. His lineage continued through Yazīd al-Tujībī, then al-Aydaʿānī. He lived into the Islamic period. Ibn Yūnus said that he witnessed the conquest of Egypt and was counted among the notable horsemen.

records.arabic: الهمداني والد عبد خير ذكره أبو عمر في ترجمة ولده وأورد من رواية عبد الملك بن سلع قال قلت لعبد خير يا أبا عمارة لقد كبرت فكم أتى عليك قال عشرون ومائة سنة قلت فهل تذكر من أمر الجاهلية شيئا قال نعم أذكر أن أمي طبخت قدرا فقلت أطعمينا فقالت حتى يجيء أبوك فجاء أبي فقال أتانا كتاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ينهانا عن لحوم الميتة فكفأناها وهكذا أورده البخاري في تاريخه وأبو يعلى من رواية عبد الملك قال بن فتحون وأورده أبو عمر في ترجمة ولده عبد خير وهو على شرطه ولم يفرده قلت لكن قال يزيد بن محمد فحرفه وانما هو يحمد بضم أوله وسكون الحاء المهملة وكسر الميم وقد قيل انه عبد خير بن يحمد ويحتمل أن يكون من قال ذلك نسبه إلى جده
records.english: al-Hamdānī. He was the father of ʿAbd Khayr. Abū ʿUmar mentioned him in the biography of his son and cited, through ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Sulaʿ, who said: “I asked ʿAbd Khayr, ‘Abū ʿUmārah, you have grown old. How many years have passed over you?’ He replied, ‘One hundred and twenty years.’ I asked, ‘Do you remember anything from the pre-Islamic period?’ He replied, ‘Yes. I remember that my mother cooked a pot of food. I said, “Feed us,” and she replied, “Not until your father comes.” My father came and said, “A letter from the Messenger of God ﷺ has reached us forbidding us to eat carrion,” so we overturned it.’” Al-Bukhārī likewise included it in his History, and Abū Yaʿlā transmitted it from ʿAbd al-Malik. Ibn Fatḥūn said: “Abū ʿUmar included it in the biography of his son ʿAbd Khayr, although it meets his criteria, and he did not give Yazīd a separate entry.” I say: He wrote “Yazīd ibn Muḥammad,” corrupting it. It is in fact Yuḥmid—with ḍammah on the first letter, sukūn on the unpointed ḥāʾ, and kasrah on the mīm. It is also said that the name was ʿAbd Khayr ibn Yuḥmid. Whoever said that may have attributed him to his grandfather.

records.arabic: والد الحسن بن أبي الحسن البصري له إدراك قال الخطيب من طريق أبي العيناء عن بن عائشة كان يسار من أهل ميسان فسبي فصار إلى بعض الأنصار فهو مولى الأنصار وولد له الحسن في أواخر خلافة عمر
records.english: The father of al-Ḥasan ibn Abī al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī. He lived into the Islamic period. Al-Khaṭīb related, through Abū al-ʿAynāʾ, from Ibn ʿĀʾishah, that Yasār was from Maysān, was taken captive, and came into the possession of one of the Anṣār. He was therefore a client of the Anṣār. His son al-Ḥasan was born near the end of ʿUmar’s caliphate.

records.arabic: مولى قيس بن مخرمة وهو جد محمد بن يسار صاحب المغازي أخرج أبو بكر بن المقرئ في فوائده من طريق محمد بن إسحاق حدثني صالح بن كيسان أن خالد بن الوليد سار حتى نزل على عين التمر فقتل وسبى وكان فيمن سبى سيرين أبو عمرة وعبد مولى بلقين وحمران بن أبان وأفلح مولى أبي أيوب ويسار مولى لقيس بن مخرمة وكان ذلك سنة إحدى عشرة من الهجرة في أول خلافة أبي بكر
records.english: A client of Qays ibn Makhramah. He was also the grandfather of Muḥammad ibn Yasār, the author on military campaigns. Abū Bakr ibn al-Muqriʾ transmitted in his Fawāʾid, through Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq: Ṣāliḥ ibn Kaysān related to me that Khālid ibn al-Walīd marched until he camped at ʿAyn al-Tamr, where he killed and took captives. Among those captured were Sīrīn, Abū ʿAmrah; ʿAbd, a client of Balaqayn; Ḥumrān ibn Abān; Aflaḥ, a client of Abū Ayyūb; and Yasār, a client of Qays ibn Makhramah. This occurred in the year eleven after the Hijrah, at the beginning of Abū Bakr’s caliphate.

records.arabic: خازن عمر له إدراك ورواية عن عمر روى عنه أبو وائل شقيق بن سلمة وغيره وأخرج بن سعد في ترجمة عمر من الطبقات من رواية أبي عاصم الغطفاني عن يسار بن نمير قال ما نخلت لعمر الدقيق قط الا وأنا له عاص وروينا في جزء عباس الترقفي من طريق غيلان بن جرير عن أبي إسحاق عن يسار بن نمير مولى عمر قال كان عمر إذا بال قال ناولني شيئا فأناوله العود أو الحجر أو يأتي إلى الحائط وأخرج البلاذري من طريق إسماعيل بن أبي خالد عن أبي بردة حدثني يسار بن نمير قال قال لي عمر كم أنفقنا في حجتنا فذكر قصة
records.english: ʿUmar's treasurer. He lived into the Islamic period and related from ʿUmar. Abū Wāʾil Shaqīq ibn Salamah and others related from him. In ʿUmar’s biography in al-Ṭabaqāt, Ibn Saʿd transmitted from Abū ʿĀṣim al-Ghaṭafānī, from Yasār ibn Numayr, who said: “I never sifted flour for ʿUmar without disobeying him.” We related in the collection of ʿAbbās al-Turaqfī, through Ghaylān ibn Jarīr, from Abū Isḥāq, from Yasār ibn Numayr, ʿUmar’s client, who said: “Whenever ʿUmar urinated, he would say, ‘Hand me something,’ and I would hand him a stick or a stone, or he would go to a wall.” Al-Balādhurī transmitted, through Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid, from Abū Burdah: Yasār ibn Numayr related to me that ʿUmar asked him, “How much did we spend on our pilgrimage?” He then related an account.

records.english: He appeared above under Usayr in the letter alif.

records.arabic: له إدراك استشهد بأجنادين في خلافة أبي بكر رأيت ذلك في تاريخ المظفري ثم وجدته في فتوح الشام للأزدي ومضى له ذكر في ترجمة والده عمرو بن ضريس قال أبو إسماعيل الأزدي شهد وقعة أجنادين وقتل يومئذ سبعة من المشركين وأصابته طعنة فمكث أربعة أيام أو خمسة ثم انتقضت فاستأذن أبا عبيدة في الرجوع إلى أهله فأذن له فمات عندهم
records.english: He lived into the Islamic period. He was also martyred at Ajnādayn during Abū Bakr’s caliphate. I saw this in al-Tārīkh al-Muẓaffarī, then found it in al-Azdī’s Futūḥ al-Shām. He was mentioned earlier in the biography of his father, ʿAmr ibn Ḍurays. Abū Ismāʿīl al-Azdī said that he witnessed the battle of Ajnādayn and killed seven polytheists that day. He received a stab wound and remained alive for four or five days. It then reopened, so he sought Abū ʿUbaydah’s permission to return to his family. He gave permission, and Yaʿqūb died among them.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الذهلي له إدراك وشهد فتح القادسية ووصفه سعد لعمر فقال ألم أر رجلا مثل يعفور انه قد جاء في يوم بخمسة فوارس يختل الرجل منهم حتى يرميه ثم يغلبه على غاية حتى يأتي به مسلما
records.english: al-Dhuhlī. He lived into the Islamic period and witnessed the conquest of al-Qādisiyyah. Saʿd described him to ʿUmar, saying: “I have never seen a man like Yaʿfūr. In a single day he brought five horsemen: he would stalk one of them until he could shoot him, then overpower him completely and bring him back alive as a prisoner.”

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن يعمر بن حارثة بن العبيد بن العمير بن سلامة بن زوى بن مالك بن نهد النهدي له إدراك وشهد فتوح العراق مع سعد بالقادسية ثم شهد صفين مع علي وكان معه لواء بني نهد ذكره بن الكلبي
records.english: son of Yaʿmar. His lineage continued through Ḥārithah ibn al-ʿUbayd ibn al-ʿUmayr ibn Salāmah ibn Zuwayy ibn Mālik ibn Nahd al-Nahdī. He lived into the Islamic period and took part in the conquests of Iraq with Saʿd at al-Qādisiyyah. He later witnessed Ṣiffīn with ʿAlī, bearing the banner of Banū Nahd. Ibn al-Kalbī mentioned him.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بفتح أوله وتشديد النون وبعد الألف قاف العماني بضم وتخفيف له إدراك أورد حديثه الدارقطني في غرائب مالك من طريق عبد الرحمن بن خالد بن نجيح عن حبيب كاتب مالك قال قدم على مالك قوم من أهل عمان حجاجا وكان فيهم رجل يقال له صدقة بن عطية بن حماس بن نجبة بن حمار بن يناق وكان مالك يكرمه ويرفع مجلسه فأمرني مالك أن أكتب منه حديثا يحدث به وأن أعرضه عليه فأملى علي قال حدثني أبي عطية بن حماس قال سمعت جدي نجبة بن حمار يحدث عن جده يناق قال كنت أرعى ابلا لأهلي في بادية لنا فجاءنا كتاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن أسلموا فأبى قومي فأرسل إليهم من صالحيهم ثم جاءتنا وفاة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فحمل قومي إلى أبي بكر ما كانوا يحملونه فسألت قومي أن يحملوني معهم إلى عمر فأبوا حتى غلبني بعضهم على إبل لي فخرجت على راحلة لي نحو المدينة فذكر قصة طويلة فيها قتل عمر قال فدخلت المدينة فذكر اجتماعه بهم في داره وهو في الموت الحديث بطوله قال حبيب فجئت إلى مالك فقرأه وقال حدثني نحو هذا نافع عن بن عمر قال ثم جاء الشيخ إلى مالك فأكرمه فحدث في مجلسه بالحديث ثم حدثهم بقصة اختلاف علي مع بن عمر في أم كلثوم بنت علي بن نعيم حتى اتفقوا على أنها تقيم عند حفصة بنت عمر إلى آخره قال الدارقطني تفرد به حبيب عن صدقة وعن مالك وقال بعد ذلك حبيب ضعيف عند أهل الحديث
records.english: With fatḥah on its first letter, a doubled nūn, and qāf after the alif. He was al-ʿUmānī, with ḍammah and a light consonant. He lived into the Islamic period. Al-Dāraquṭnī included his report in Gharāʾib Mālik, through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Khālid ibn Najīḥ, from Ḥabīb, Mālik’s scribe, who said: “A group of pilgrims from Oman came to Mālik. Among them was a man called Ṣadaqah ibn ʿAṭiyyah ibn Ḥammās ibn Najabah ibn Ḥimār ibn Yannaq. Mālik honored him and gave him a prominent place in his gathering. Mālik instructed me to write down a report he related and present it to him. The man dictated to me: ‘My father, ʿAṭiyyah ibn Ḥammās, related to me: I heard my grandfather Najabah ibn Ḥimār relate from his grandfather Yannaq, who said: I was tending camels for my family in our desert land when a letter from the Messenger of God ﷺ reached us saying, “Embrace Islam.” My people refused, so he sent to them some righteous men from among them. Then news of the death of the Messenger of God ﷺ reached us. My people carried to Abū Bakr what they had formerly carried. I asked them to take me with them to ʿUmar, but they refused. Then one of them wrongfully seized some camels of mine, so I set out on a riding camel toward Medina.’” He then related a long account concerning the killing of ʿUmar. He said that he entered Medina and recounted meeting them in ʿUmar’s house while he was dying; this is the report in full. Ḥabīb said: “I went to Mālik and read it to him. He said, ‘Nāfiʿ related something similar to me from Ibn ʿUmar.’ The shaykh then came to Mālik, who honored him, and he related the report in Mālik’s gathering. He next related to them the account of the disagreement between ʿAlī and Ibn ʿUmar concerning Umm Kulthūm bint ʿAlī ibn Nuʿaym, until they agreed that she should stay with Ḥafṣah bint ʿUmar,” to the end of the account. Al-Dāraquṭnī said that Ḥabīb alone transmitted it from Ṣadaqah and from Mālik. He later said that Ḥabīb was considered weak by hadith scholars.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن العاص تابعي وسط وقال أبو موسى في الذيل ذكر أبو داود في السنن عن الشعبي عن مالك عن يحيى بن سعيد يعني الأنصاري عن القاسم بن محمد وسليمان بن يسار أنهما سمعاهما يقولان ان يحيى بن سعيد بن العاص طلق بنت عبد الرحمن ألبتة فانتقلها عبد الرحمن فأرسلت عائشة إلى مروان وهو أمير المدينة فقالت أتقوا الله وردوا المرأة إلى بيتها الحديث قال بن الأثير يحيى هذا هو أخو عمرو بن سعيد الأشدق وليست لهما صحبة ولا إدراك فان أباهما سعيد بن العاص ولد سنة الهجرة وليس يحيى أكبر ولده فمن كل وجه لا صحبة له فكيف اشتبه هذا على أبي موسى انتهى والحديث عند البخاري أيضا عن إسماعيل عن مالك وفيه طلق بنت عبد الرحمن بن الحكم وأخرجه من طريق عبد الرحمن بن القاسم عن أبيه قال قال عروة لعائشة ألم ترى إلى فلانة بنت الحكم طلقها زوجها ألبتة فخرجت فقالت بئسما صنعت فكأنها نسبت في هذه الرواية إلى جدها ولم يسم زوجها وهو يحيى بن سعيد المذكور وكان يحيى
records.english: son of al-ʿĀṣ. He was a middle-generation Successor. Abū Mūsā said in the supplement: Abū Dāwūd mentioned in al-Sunan, from al-Shaʿbī, from Mālik, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd—meaning al-Anṣārī—from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad and Sulaymān ibn Yasār, that he heard them say that Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ divorced the daughter of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān irrevocably, and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān moved her away. ʿĀʾishah sent word to Marwān, who was governor of Medina, saying: “Fear God and return the woman to her house.” This is the report. Ibn al-Athīr said: “This Yaḥyā was the brother of ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Ashdaq. Neither had companionship nor lived during the Prophet’s time, for their father Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ was born in the year of the Hijrah, and Yaḥyā was not his eldest son. From every perspective he had no companionship, so how did this confuse Abū Mūsā?” End of quotation. The report also appears in al-Bukhārī from Ismāʿīl, from Mālik, where it says that he divorced the daughter of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥakam. He also transmitted it through ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, who said: ʿUrwah asked ʿĀʾishah, “Have you not seen so-and-so, daughter of al-Ḥakam? Her husband divorced her irrevocably, and she left.” She replied, “What she did was wretched.” It appears that in this version she was attributed to her grandfather. Her husband is not named, but he was the aforementioned Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd. The source then begins, “Yaḥyā was,” but breaks off before completing the assertion.

heading.arabic: القسم الرابع ذكر في كتب الصحابة غلطا
heading.english: The Fourth Division: Those Erroneously Mentioned in Books on the Companions

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تابعي صغير أرسل شيئا فذكره يحيى بن يونس في الصحابة وأخرج من طريق إبراهيم بن يزيد هو الخوري عن يحيى بن صيفي قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من سعادة المرء أن يشبهه ولده قال المستغفري بعد ذكره في الصحابة هذا مرسل ولا يعرف ليحيى صحبة قلت وله خبر آخر مرسل أخرجه أبو سعيد بن الأعرابي في معجمه من رواية السائب بن عمر المخزومي عن يحيى بن صيفي قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من أزلفت اليه يد كان عليه من الحق أن يجزى بها فان لم يفعل فليظهر الثناء فان لم يفعل فقد كفر النعمة وجوز بعضهم أن يكون هو يحيى بن عبد الله بن صيفي المخرج له في الصحيح من روايته عن أبي سعيد مولى بن عباس عنه وكأنه نسبه في هذين الحديثين الصحيحين لجده قال بن سعد كان ثقة وله أحاديث وذكره بن حبان في ثقات أتباع التابعين
records.english: A younger Successor. He transmitted something without a connected chain, so Yaḥyā ibn Yūnus mentioned him among the Companions. He transmitted, through Ibrāhīm ibn Yazīd—namely al-Khawrī—from Yaḥyā ibn Ṣayfī, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Part of a man’s good fortune is that his child resembles him.” After mentioning him among the Companions, al-Mustaghfirī said: “This is disconnected, and Yaḥyā is not known to have had companionship.” I say: He has another disconnected report, transmitted by Abū Saʿīd ibn al-Aʿrābī in his Muʿjam through al-Sāʾib ibn ʿUmar al-Makhzūmī, from Yaḥyā ibn Ṣayfī, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever has a favor extended to him owes the right of recompensing it. If he does not do so, let him declare his praise; and if he does not do that, he has denied the blessing.” Some allowed that he may be Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṣayfī, whose report appears in the Ṣaḥīḥ through Abū Saʿīd, the client of Ibn ʿAbbās, from him. It is as though the two reports attributed him to his grandfather. Ibn Saʿd said that he was trustworthy and had reports. Ibn Ḥibbān mentioned him among the trustworthy Followers of the Successors.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن قانع في الصحابة وأورد له من طريق شعبة عن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة عن عمه يحيى بن عبد الرحمن أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كوى أسعد بن زرارة وقد أخطأ وانما هو عن عمه يحيى بن أسعد بن زرارة كما تقدم
records.english: Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him among the Companions. He cited, through Shuʿbah, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Saʿd ibn Zurārah, from his paternal uncle Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, that the Prophet ﷺ cauterized Asʿad ibn Zurārah. This is an error. It is instead from his paternal uncle Yaḥyā ibn Asʿad ibn Zurārah, as stated earlier.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تابعي أرسل شيئا فذكره بعضهم في الصحابة وقال أبو حمد العسكري روايته مرسلة
records.english: A Successor. He transmitted something without a connected chain, so some mentioned him among the Companions. Abū Aḥmad al-ʿAskarī said that his transmission was disconnected.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عروة المرادي تابعي صغير أرسل شيئا فذكره بن شاهين في الصحابة وأورده من طريق بن الكلبي حدثنا أبو كبران المرادي عن يحيى بن هانئ بن عروة المرادي قال وفد فروة بن مسيك على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مفارقا ملوك كندة فذكر الحديث قلت وأبوه هانئ بن عروة معدود في المخضرمين وقد مضى في حرف الهاء وليحيى رواية عن أنس ونعيم بن دجاجة وأبي حذيفة وغيرهم روى عنه شعبة والثوري وشريك وأبو بكر بن عياش وغيرهم قال أبو حاتم الرازي ثقة صالح من سادات أهل الكوفة وذكره بن حبان في في ثقات أتباع التابعين وقال يحيى بن بكير عن شعبة كان سيد أهل الكوفة في زمانه ووثقه النسائي وغيره وحديثه في السنن الثلاثة
records.english: son of ʿUrwah. He was al-Murādī, a junior Successor. He transmitted something without a connected chain, so Ibn Shāhīn mentioned him among the Companions. Ibn Shāhīn cited it through Ibn al-Kalbī: Abū Kabrān al-Murādī narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Hāniʾ ibn ʿUrwah al-Murādī, who said: “Farwah ibn Musayk came in a delegation to the Prophet ﷺ after separating himself from the kings of Kindah,” and then related the report. I say: His father Hāniʾ ibn ʿUrwah is counted among those who lived across the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods and appeared earlier under the letter hāʾ. Yaḥyā related from Anas, Nuʿaym ibn Dajājah, Abū Ḥudhayfah, and others. Shuʿbah, al-Thawrī, Sharīk, Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh, and others related from him. Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī said: “A trustworthy and upright man, one of the notables of Kufa.” Ibn Ḥibbān mentioned him among the trustworthy Followers of the Successors. Yaḥyā ibn Bukayr related from Shuʿbah that he was the leading man of Kufa in his time. Al-Nasāʾī and others declared him trustworthy, and his hadiths appear in the three Sunan collections.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: صوابه زيد أوله زاي كما تقدم في حرف الزاي
records.english: The correct form is Zayd, beginning with zāy. This was stated earlier under the letter zāy.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن قانع واستدركه بن الدباغ على بن عبد البر فوهم فان بن عبد البر ذكره على الصواب فقال يزيد بن سيف أو يوسف ولم يسم جده فظن بن الدباغ أنه لم يذكره وأن بن قانع نسبه لجده وقد نسبه على الصواب البغوي وابن السكن والطبراني وساقوا حديثه كما تقدم
records.english: Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him. Ibn al-Dabbāgh also added him to Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr’s work, but this was an error. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr had mentioned him correctly, saying “Yazīd ibn Sayf—or Yūsuf,” without naming his grandfather. Ibn al-Dabbāgh therefore thought that Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr had omitted him and that Ibn Qāniʿ had attributed him to his grandfather. Al-Baghawī, Ibn al-Sakan, and al-Ṭabarānī gave his lineage correctly and cited his report, as stated earlier.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عامر بن العطاف ذكره بن شاهين وذكر فبله يزيد بن جارية بن مجمع بن العطاف وهما واحد وهو بن جارية بن عامر بن مجمع بن العطاف كما تقدم في الأول
records.english: son of ʿĀmir. His lineage continued through al-ʿAṭṭāf. Ibn Shāhīn mentioned him, having previously mentioned Yazīd ibn Jāriyah ibn Mujammiʿ ibn al-ʿAṭṭāf. They are one man: he is Ibn Jāriyah ibn ʿĀmir ibn Mujammiʿ ibn al-ʿAṭṭāf, as stated in the first entry.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: آخر يأتي قريبا في يزيد بن خارجة بن عامر
records.english: Another man. He will appear shortly under Yazīd ibn Khārijah ibn ʿĀmir.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن نمير السكوني الحمصي من صغار التابعين مات في خلافة يزيد بن عبد الملك سنة ثلاث ومائة وكان سليمان بن عبد الملك ولاه حمص ثم ولاه عمر بن عبد العزيز وكان شهد مع مروان بن الحكم دخوله مصر وأبوه حصين بن نمير وهو الذي استخلفه مسلم بن عقبة المري بعد وقعة الحرة على العسكر الذي غزا به المدينة النبوية في خلافة يزيد بن معاوية فغزا حصين مكة وحاصر بن الزبير حتى بلغهم وفاة يزيد بن معاوية وليست لحصين صحبة فضلا عن ولده وانما التبس على من ذكره في الصحابة بآخر وافقه في اسمه واسم أبيه كما تقدم في الأول
records.english: son of Numayr. He was al-Sakūnī al-Ḥimṣī, one of the junior Successors. He died during the caliphate of Yazīd ibn ʿAbd al-Malik in the year 103. Sulaymān ibn ʿAbd al-Malik had appointed him governor of Homs, and ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz retained him there. He had accompanied Marwān ibn al-Ḥakam when Marwān entered Egypt. His father was Ḥuṣayn ibn Numayr, whom Muslim ibn ʿUqbah al-Murrī placed in command after the Battle of al-Ḥarrah over the army with which he attacked the Prophet’s city during the caliphate of Yazīd ibn Muʿāwiyah. Ḥuṣayn then attacked Mecca and besieged Ibn al-Zubayr until news of Yazīd ibn Muʿāwiyah’s death reached them. Ḥuṣayn had no companionship, much less his son. Whoever mentioned the son among the Companions confused him with another man who shared his name and his father’s name, as stated in the first entry.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: جاء ذكره في حديث إبراهيم بن عبد الأعلى عن جدته عن أبيها يزيد بن حنظلة قال خرجنا ومعنا وائل بن حجر فأخذه عدو له فتحرج القوم أن يحلفوا فحلف بالله أنه أخي الحديث أخرجه البغوي عن هارون الحمال عن يزيد بن هارون عنه قال هارون يزيد وقال مرة أخرى سويد بن حنظلة وكان يشك فيه قلت رواه أحمد في مسنده عن يزيد فقال عن سويد لم يشك فيه وكذا قال البغوي رواه غير يزيد عن إسرائيل قلت هو عند أبي داود وابن ماجة وغيرهما من طرق عن إسرائيل كذلك وذكر يزيد فيه وهم
records.english: He is mentioned in the report of Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd al-Aʿlā. The chain continues through his grandmother, from her father Yazīd ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said: “We set out with Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr. An enemy of his seized him, and the people were reluctant to swear an oath, so he swore by God, ‘He is my brother.’” This is the report. Al-Baghawī transmitted it from Hārūn al-Ḥammāl, from Yazīd ibn Hārūn, from him. Hārūn said “Yazīd,” but on another occasion said “Suwayd ibn Ḥanẓalah”; he was uncertain about it. I say: Aḥmad related it in his Musnad from Yazīd and said “from Suwayd,” without uncertainty. Al-Baghawī likewise said that others besides Yazīd related it from Isrāʾīl. I say: It appears in Abū Dāwūd, Ibn Mājah, and elsewhere through routes from Isrāʾīl in that form. Mentioning Yazīd is an error.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: استدركه بن فتحون وعزاه للبغوي وهو وهم نشأ عن تصحيف قال البغوي حدثنا سويد بن معاوية عن عثمان بن حكيم عن خالد بن سلمة عن موسى بن طلحة عن يزيد بن خارجة الخزرجي سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كيف نصلى عليك الحديث والصواب زيد أوله زاي وقد أخرجه البغوي هناك من وجهين عن عثمان وكذا هو عن أحمد والنسائي من طريق عيسى بن يونس عن عثمان وأخرجه بن أبي عاصم من طريق عيسى لكن قال خارجة بن زيد وهو مقلوب وقد وهم فيه سويد وهما آخر فأخرجه أبو نعيم من طريق مطين عنه قال يزيد بن حارثة حرف اسم أبيه والصواب خارجة والله أعلم
records.english: Ibn Fatḥūn added him as an omission. He attributed the entry to al-Baghawī, but it is an error arising from a scribal corruption. Al-Baghawī said: Suwayd ibn Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn Ḥakīm, from Khālid ibn Salamah, from Mūsā ibn Ṭalḥah, from Yazīd ibn Khārijah al-Khazrajī: “I asked the Prophet ﷺ, ‘How should we invoke blessings upon you?’” This is the report. The correct name is Zayd, beginning with zāy. Al-Baghawī transmitted it there through two routes from ʿUthmān. It likewise appears in Aḥmad and al-Nasāʾī through ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus, from ʿUthmān. Ibn Abī ʿĀṣim transmitted it through ʿĪsā but said “Khārijah ibn Zayd,” reversing the name. Suwayd made another error in it: Abū Nuʿaym transmitted it through Muṭayyan from him with “Yazīd ibn Ḥārithah,” corrupting the father’s name. The correct form is Khārijah. والله أعلم

records.arabic: العرني نزل حمص في امارة معاوية كذا ذكره بن شاهين فوهم فإنه تابعي معروف أكبر شيخ له أبو الدرداء وقد ذكره البخاري وابن أبي حاتم وابن حبان وغيرهم في التابعين
records.english: al-ʿUranī. He settled in Homs during Muʿāwiyah’s governorship. Ibn Shāhīn recorded him in this form and erred, for he was a well-known Successor whose earliest teacher was Abū al-Dardāʾ. Al-Bukhārī, Ibn Abī Ḥātim, Ibn Ḥibbān, and others listed him among the Successors.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره البغوي وأورد من طريق سعيد بن مسروق عن بن أشوع عن يزيد بن سلمة قال قلت يا رسول الله اني سمعت منك حديثا كثيرا وأخاف أن أنساه الحديث قال البغوي أظنه غير الجعفي قلت فقد أخرجه بن منده من طريق بن أشوع فقال عن يزيد بن سلمة الجعفي وأخرجه الترمذي كذلك وتقدم على الصواب في القسم الأول
records.english: Al-Baghawī mentioned him. He cited, through Saʿīd ibn Masrūq, from Ibn Ashwaʿ, from Yazīd ibn Salamah, who said: “I said, ‘Messenger of God, I have heard many reports from you and fear that I will forget them . . .’” This is the report. Al-Baghawī said: “I think he is someone other than al-Juʿfī.” I say: Ibn Mandah transmitted it through Ibn Ashwaʿ and said “from Yazīd ibn Salamah al-Juʿfī.” Al-Tirmidhī transmitted it in the same form. The correct account appeared earlier in the first division.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره أبو بكر بن أبي علي وأخرج من طريق إسماعيل بن عياش عن بن خثيم عن جعفر بن يزيد بن صحار العبدي عن أبيه رفعه لا يشرب في الخزف والجر والنقير قلت صحفه بعض الرواة عن إسماعيل وانما هو زيد أوله زاي وقد أورده بن منده من وجه آخر عن إسماعيل فقال عن جعفر بن زيد عن أبيه على الصواب
records.english: Abū Bakr ibn Abī ʿAlī mentioned him. He transmitted, through Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Jaʿfar ibn Yazīd ibn Ṣaḥār al-ʿAbdī, from his father, who raised it to the Prophet: “Do not drink from pottery, earthen jars, or hollowed wooden vessels.” I say: One of the transmitters from Ismāʿīl corrupted the name. It is in fact Zayd, beginning with zāy. Ibn Mandah included it through another route from Ismāʿīl and said “from Jaʿfar ibn Zayd, from his father,” correctly.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن ركانة قال المستغفري ذكره يحيى بن يونس الشيرازي في الصحابة وأورد له من طريق مالك عن سلمة بن صفوان عنه رفعه لكل دين خلق وخلق الإسلام الحياة قال المستغفري هذا مرسل ويزيد هذا هو أخو محمد بن طلحة بن ركانة تابعي معروف وقال بن أبي حاتم روى عن أبيه ومحمد بن الحنفية وذكره بن حبان في ثقات التابعين وقال روى عن أبي هريرة ومات في أول خلافة هشام بن عبد الملك وذكر بن عبد البر أن جمهور الرواة عن مالك قالوا هكذا وقال وكيع وحده عن يزيد بن طلحة عن أبيه زاد فيه عن أبيه وقال ورواه يحيى بن يحيى الليثي كالجمهور فقال زيد بدل يزيد وقال بن عبد البر يكون على قول وكيع الحديث مسندا كذا قال ولم يذكر طلحة في الاستيعاب وعليه فيه تعقيب آخر فان الذي أخرجه الدارقطني في غرائب مالك من طريق وكيع قال عن مالك عن سلمة عن يزيد بن ركانة عن أبيه فعلى هذا الصحبة لركانة قال الدارقطني ورواه علي بن زيد الصدائي عن مالك كذلك لكن قال يزيد بن طلحة بن ركانة
records.english: son of Rukānah. Al-Mustaghfirī said that Yaḥyā ibn Yūnus al-Shīrāzī mentioned him among the Companions and cited for him, through Mālik, from Salamah ibn Ṣafwān, from him, raising it to the Prophet: “Every religion has a character, and the character of Islam is life [al-ḥayāh].” An internal parallel reads “modesty [al-ḥayāʾ],” but the locked reading here remains textually unresolved. Al-Mustaghfirī said: “This is disconnected. This Yazīd was the brother of Muḥammad ibn Ṭalḥah ibn Rukānah, a well-known Successor.” Ibn Abī Ḥātim said that he related from his father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥanafiyyah. Ibn Ḥibbān mentioned him among the trustworthy Successors, said that he related from Abū Hurayrah, and stated that he died at the beginning of Hishām ibn ʿAbd al-Malik’s caliphate. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr stated that most transmitters from Mālik related it in this form, whereas Wakīʿ alone said “from Yazīd ibn Ṭalḥah, from his father,” adding “from his father.” Yaḥyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Laythī transmitted it like the majority but said Zayd in place of Yazīd. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr said that in Wakīʿ’s version the report would have a connected chain. That is what he said, though he did not mention Ṭalḥah in al-Istīʿāb, which creates another objection. The version al-Dāraquṭnī transmitted in Gharāʾib Mālik through Wakīʿ says: “from Mālik, from Salamah, from Yazīd ibn Rukānah, from his father.” On that version, companionship belongs to Rukānah. Al-Dāraquṭnī said that ʿAlī ibn Zayd al-Ṣudāʾī likewise related it from Mālik, but said Yazīd ibn Ṭalḥah ibn Rukānah.

records.arabic: بن ركانة بن المطلب المطلبي ذكره بعضهم في الصحابة لحديث أرسله أخرجه البيهقي في الدعوات من طريق إبراهيم بن المنذر عن الحسن بن زيد عن جعفر بن محمد عن أبيه عن يزيد بن عبد الله بن ركانة بن المطلب قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قدم اليه الجنازة ليصلي عليها قال اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك الحديث
records.english: son of Rukānah. His lineage continued through al-Muṭṭalib al-Muṭṭalibī. Some mentioned him among the Companions because of a report he transmitted without a connected chain. Al-Bayhaqī transmitted it in al-Daʿawāt, through Ibrāhīm ibn al-Mundhir, from al-Ḥasan ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rukānah ibn al-Muṭṭalib, who said: “When a funeral bier was brought before the Messenger of God ﷺ so that he might pray over it, he would say: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك . . .” This is the report.

formulas.observedArabic: اللهم عبدك وابن عبدك احتاج إلى رحمتك

records.arabic: أبو العلاء أحد كبار التابعين ذكر أبو موسى في الذيل أن يحيى بن عبد الوهاب بن منده استدركه على جده وأورد من طريق هشيم عن يونس بن عبيد عن يزيد بن عبد الله بن الشخير وأظنه رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ان الله يبتلي العبد فيما أعطاه فان رضي بارك له وان لم يرض لم يبارك له انتهى وقول من قال أظنه رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم غلط فان البخاري روى في تاريخه من طريقه أنه ولد قبل الحسن بعشر سنين وكان مولد الحسن في أواخر خلافة عمر فيكون مولد يزيد في خلافة أبي بكر
records.english: Known as Abū al-ʿAlāʾ. He was one of the senior Successors. Abū Mūsā mentioned in the supplement that Yaḥyā ibn ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn Mandah added him to his grandfather’s work and cited, through Hushaym, from Yūnus ibn ʿUbayd, from Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Shikhkhīr: “I think he saw the Prophet ﷺ. He said, ‘God tests a servant concerning what He has given him. If the servant is content, He blesses it for him; if he is not content, He does not bless it for him.’” End of quotation. The statement “I think he saw the Prophet ﷺ” is erroneous. Al-Bukhārī related in his History, through Yazīd, that he was born ten years before al-Ḥasan. Al-Ḥasan was born near the end of ʿUmar’s caliphate, so Yazīd’s birth would have occurred during Abū Bakr’s caliphate.

title.arabic: يزيد بن عبد الله بن الشخير
title.english: Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Shikhkhīr

records.arabic: ذكره أبو نعيم وأخرجه من طريق عاصم بن عبد الله عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد عن أبيه رفعه قال أرقاكم أرقاءكم الحديث قال أبو نعيم يقال انه يزيد بن جارية قال بن الأثير هو هو بلا شبهة وقد تقدم الحديث المذكور في ترجمته
records.english: Abū Nuʿaym mentioned him. He transmitted, through ʿĀṣim ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yazīd, from his father, raising it to the Prophet: “Your slaves—your slaves . . .” This is the report. Abū Nuʿaym said: “It is said that he was Yazīd ibn Jāriyah.” Ibn al-Athīr said: “He is unquestionably the same man.” The report appeared earlier in his biography.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: المزني حجازي استدركه أبو موسى وأخرج بن ماجة من طريق أيوب بن موسى عنه رفعه يعق عن الغلام ويزيد هذا تابعي قال البخاري إنما روى هذا الحديث عن أبيه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ولم تثبت صحبة أبيه أيضا
records.english: al-Muzanī. He was a man of the Hijaz. Abū Mūsā added him. Ibn Mājah transmitted, through Ayyūb ibn Mūsā, from him, raising it to the Prophet: “An ʿaqīqah is offered for a boy.” This Yazīd was a Successor. Al-Bukhārī said that he in fact related this report from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, and his father’s companionship is not established either.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أبو وجزة ذكره بن شاهين في الصحابة وأخرج من طريق بن أبي ذئب عن عبد الله بن محمد بن عمر بن حاطب عن أبي وجزة يزيد بن عبيد قال لما قفل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من غزوة تبوك أتاه وفد بني فزارة فيهم خارجة بن حصين والحارث بن قيس وهو أصغرهم فنزلوا في دار رملة بنت الحارث وهذا مرسل وأبو وجزة تابعي مشهور بالسعدي وقد أخرج هذا الحديث الواقدي في المغازي من هذا الوجه فقال في سياقه عن أبي وجزة السعدي وقد حكى المزرباني عن المبرد أن أبا وجزة سلمي الأصل وانما قيل له السعدي لأنه نزل في بني سعد قلت والحديث المذكور من مراسيله وحديث أبي وجزة هذا في السنن عن عمر بن أبي سلمة المخزومي ربيب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وكان شاعرا مشهورا سكن المدينة ومات بها سنة ثلاثين ومائة
records.english: Known as Abū Wajzah. Ibn Shāhīn mentioned him among the Companions and transmitted, through Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿUmar ibn Ḥāṭib, from Abū Wajzah Yazīd ibn ʿUbayd, who said: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ returned from the expedition of Tabūk, a delegation from Banū Fazārah came to him. They included Khārijah ibn Ḥiṣn and al-Ḥārith ibn Qays, who was the youngest of them. They lodged in the house of Ramlah bint al-Ḥārith.” This report is disconnected. Abū Wajzah was a well-known Successor called al-Saʿdī. Al-Wāqidī transmitted this report in al-Maghāzī through this route and said in his account “from Abū Wajzah al-Saʿdī.” Al-Marzubānī related from al-Mubarrad that Abū Wajzah was Sulamī by origin and was called Saʿdī only because he settled among Banū Saʿd. I say: The cited report is one of his disconnected transmissions. Abū Wajzah’s hadith in the Sunan collections is from ʿUmar ibn Abī Salamah al-Makhzūmī, the stepson of the Prophet ﷺ. Abū Wajzah was a famous poet; he settled in Medina and died there in the year 130.

records.arabic: عده المستغفري في الصحابة استدركه بن فتحون وقد ذكره أبو عمر لكن قال يزيد بن عمرو وقد بينت الخلاف فيه في القسم الأول
records.english: Al-Mustaghfirī counted him among the Companions. Ibn Fatḥūn also added him. Abū ʿUmar had mentioned him, but called him Yazīd ibn ʿAmr. I explained the disagreement concerning him in the first division.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره المستغفري في الصحابة وأخرج من طريق أيوب عن ميمون بن مهران قال كتب الي بن عمر سل يزيد بن عمرو عن نكاح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ميمونة فسألته فقال نكحها حلال قلت ويزيد هذا هو يزيد بن الأصم وقد ذكره بن منده وقد تقدم ذكره في القسم الثاني
records.english: Al-Mustaghfirī mentioned him among the Companions. He transmitted, through Ayyūb, from Maymūn ibn Mihrān, who said: “Ibn ʿUmar wrote to me: ‘Ask Yazīd ibn ʿAmr about the Messenger of God’s ﷺ marriage to Maymūnah.’ I asked him, and he replied, ‘He married her while free of ritual consecration.’” I say: This Yazīd was Yazīd ibn al-Aṣamm. Ibn Mandah mentioned him, and he appeared earlier in the second division.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: قيل هو اسم البهزي المذكور في حديث عمير بن سلمة الضمري الماضي في ترجمته ذكره بن عبد البر والصواب زيد كما تقدم ذكره الدارقطني وغيره
records.english: It is said that this was the name of al-Bahzī. He is the man mentioned in the hadith of ʿUmayr ibn Salamah al-Ḍamrī, cited earlier in his biography. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr mentioned it. The correct form is Zayd, as al-Dāraquṭnī and others stated earlier.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: والد عبد خير كذا ذكره بن فتحون وابن الأمين والذهبي والصواب يزيد بن يحمد بضم الياء التحتانية أوله وسكون الحاء وكسر الميم
records.english: The father of ʿAbd Khayr. Ibn Fatḥūn, Ibn al-Amīn, and al-Dhahabī recorded him in this form. The correct name is Yazīd ibn Yuḥmid—with ḍammah on the initial yāʾ, sukūn on the ḥāʾ, and kasrah on the mīm.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن قيس بن عدي بن أمية الأنصاري الخزرجي قال أبو عمر سماه الواقدي وسماه الجمهور زيدا وهو الصواب
records.english: son of Qays. His lineage continued through ʿAdī ibn Umayyah al-Anṣārī al-Khazrajī. Abū ʿUmar said that al-Wāqidī named him Yazīd, while the majority named him Zayd, which is correct.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: القيسي الزبعي اليمامي وهم من جعله غير يزيد بن معبد الحنفي الدؤلي بل هو واحد
records.english: al-Qaysī al-Zubaʿī al-Yamāmī. Whoever treated him as someone other than Yazīd ibn Maʿbad al-Ḥanafī al-Duʾalī erred; they are one man.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: النميري استدركه بن فتحون فوهم فإنه يزيد بن نمير الذي ذكره أبو عمر
records.english: al-Numayrī. Ibn Fatḥūn added him and erred, for he is Yazīd ibn Numayr, whom Abū ʿUmar mentioned.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن هزال الأسلمي تابعي مشهور أرسل حديثا فاستدركه الأشيري وتبعه بن الأثير فوهم والحديث أورد له من مسند بقي بن مخلد معروف من روايته عن أبيه ويزيد قد ذكره البخاري ومسلم وابن أبي حاتم وابن حبان وغيرهم من التابعين
records.english: son of Hazzāl. He was al-Aslamī, a well-known Successor. He transmitted a hadith without a connected chain, so al-Ashīrī added him, followed by Ibn al-Athīr, but this was an error. The report cited for him from the Musnad of Baqī ibn Makhlad is known from his transmission through his father. Al-Bukhārī, Muslim, Ibn Abī Ḥātim, Ibn Ḥibbān, and others listed Yazīd among the Successors.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الشامي ذكره بن شاهين في الصحابة فوهم وانما روايته عن المقعد عن الذي مر بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو يصلي بتبوك وقال بن أبي حاتم يزيد بن نمران قال رأيت رجلا بتبوك مقعدا له صحبة فكأن بن شاهين ظن أن الضمير في قوله له صحبة ليزيد وانما هو للرجل المقعد
records.english: al-Shāmī. Ibn Shāhīn mentioned him among the Companions and erred. His report was from the disabled man concerning the person who passed before the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying at Tabūk. Ibn Abī Ḥātim said: “Yazīd ibn Nimrān said, ‘At Tabūk I saw a disabled man who had companionship.’” It appears that Ibn Shāhīn thought that the pronoun in “who had companionship” referred to Yazīd, whereas it referred to the disabled man.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تقدم أنه تصحيف
records.english: It was noted above that this is a scribal corruption.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: والد عبد الله الخطمي روى حديث إنما الرقوب وفيه نظر كذا أورده بن منده وابن الأثير فوهم لأنهم قد ذكروه وهو يزيد بن حصين
records.english: The father of ʿAbd Allāh al-Khaṭmī. He related the hadith beginning “The bereaved one is only . . .,” though there is a problem with this. Ibn Mandah and Ibn al-Athīr included him in this form and erred, for they had already mentioned him: he is Yazīd ibn Ḥuṣayn.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: استدركه أبو موسى وأخرج من طريق هانئ بن يزيد عن أبيه أن أخاه بشر بن معبد وحارثة بن ظفر اقتتلا فوهم في استدراكه فإنه يزيد بن معبد الذي ذكره بن منده
records.english: Abū Mūsā added him as an omission. He transmitted, through Hāniʾ ibn Yazīd, from his father, that his brother Bishr ibn Maʿbad and Ḥārithah ibn Ẓafar fought one another. He erred in adding this entry, for the man is Yazīd ibn Maʿbad, whom Ibn Mandah mentioned.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أرسل حديثا فذكره المستغفري في الصحابة وقال لا أعرف له صحبة قلت جزم بن أبي حاتم بأن حديثه مرسل رواه بقية عن نافع بن يزيد عن نافع بن سليمان عن يزيد العقيلي قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سيكون في أمتي قوم يسد الله بهم الثغور الحديث
records.english: He transmitted a report without a connected chain. Therefore, al-Mustaghfirī mentioned him among the Companions and said: “I do not know of any companionship for him.” I say: Ibn Abī Ḥātim stated decisively that his report was disconnected. Baqiyyah related it from Nāfiʿ ibn Yazīd, from Nāfiʿ ibn Sulaymān, from Yazīd al-ʿUqaylī, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “There will be among my community people through whom God will guard the frontier posts . . .” This is the report.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: والد حكيم روى حديثه حماد بن سلمة عن عطاء بن السائب عن حكيم بن يزيد عن أبيه والصواب عن حكيم بن أبي يزيد كما سيأتي في الكنى
records.english: The father of Ḥakīm. Ḥammād ibn Salamah related his report from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from Ḥakīm ibn Yazīd, from his father. The correct chain is “from Ḥakīm ibn Abī Yazīd,” as will appear under the kunyahs.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: مولى بني عمرو بن عوف ذكره بن الفرضي في المؤتلف واستدركه بن الأثير وتبعه في التجريد وهو أبو ليلى والد عبد الرحمن ووهم من فرق بينهما فقد ذكر أبو عمر الاختلاف في اسمه ومن جملة ما قيل فيه يسر بن نمير وهو قول البخاري والعقيلي كما تقدم
records.english: A client of Banū ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf. Ibn al-Faraḍī mentioned him in al-Muʾtalif, and Ibn al-Athīr added him, followed by al-Dhahabī in al-Tajrīd. He is Abū Laylā, the father of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, and whoever distinguished them erred. Abū ʿUmar mentioned the disagreement over his name, among whose reported forms was Yusr ibn Numayr. This was the view of al-Bukhārī and al-ʿUqaylī, as stated earlier.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بضم أوله ثم سكون المهملة بن عبد الله أحد الكذابين الذين ادعوا الصحبة زعم حسين بن خارجة أنه لقيه بمصر وذكر له أن عمره ثلاثمائة سنة وأخرج بن عساكر في السباعيات من طريق حسين بن خارجة عنه عدة أحاديث وقال الذهبي في الميزان الإسناد اليه ظلمات وهو المذكور في بيتي السلفي المشهورين في أولهما حديث بن نسطور ويسر ونعيم هو يسر هذا وسيأتي ذكر نعيم بعد هذا بقليل
records.english: With ḍammah on its first letter, followed by sukūn on the undotted letter. He was the son of ʿAbd Allāh and one of the liars who claimed companionship. Ḥusayn ibn Khārijah claimed that he met him in Egypt and that Yusr told him he was three hundred years old. In al-Subāʿiyyāt, Ibn ʿAsākir transmitted several hadiths from him through Ḥusayn ibn Khārijah. Al-Dhahabī said in al-Mīzān: “The chain leading to him is darkness upon darkness.” He is the man mentioned in al-Silafī’s two well-known lines, the first of which contains: “The hadith of Ibn Nasṭūr, Yusr, and Nuʿaym.” This is that Yusr. Nuʿaym will be mentioned shortly after this.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: المخزومي تابعي صغير معروف أخرج الحاكم حديثه في مستدركه رواه من طريق إسماعيل بن أبي أويس عن محمد بن طلحة التيمي عن عبد الرحمن بن بي بكر بن المغيرة قال مر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالسوق برجل يبيع طعاما بسعر هو أرخص من سعر السوق الحديث فظن الحاكم أنه صحابي وانما هو تابعي وقد أخرج أبو داود حديثه في المراسيل من طريق الزبير بن سعيد عن اليسع بن المغيرة قال شكا خالد بن الوليد إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ضيق منزله فقال اتسع في البكاء وقد وصله الطبراني في رواية اليسع المذكور عن أبيه عن خالد بن الوليد ولليسع أيضا رواية عن عطاء بن أبي رباح ومحمد بن سيرين وغيرهما وقال فيه أبو حاتم الرازي ليس بالقوي وذكره بن أبي حاتم وابن حبان في ثقات التابعين
records.english: al-Makhzūmī. He was a well-known junior Successor. Al-Ḥākim included his hadith in al-Mustadrak, transmitting it through Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Uways, from Muḥammad ibn Ṭalḥah al-Taymī, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakr ibn al-Mughīrah, who said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ passed through the market by a man selling food at a price lower than the market price . . .” This is the report. Al-Ḥākim thought that al-Yasaʿ was a Companion, but he was a Successor. Abū Dāwūd transmitted his report in al-Marāsīl, through al-Zubayr ibn Saʿīd, from al-Yasaʿ ibn al-Mughīrah, who said: “Khālid ibn al-Walīd complained to the Messenger of God ﷺ about the narrowness of his dwelling, and he said, ‘Make it spacious in al-bukāʾ,’ preserving an unresolved source reading whose intended sense cannot be established.” Al-Ṭabarānī connected this report in the narration of the aforementioned al-Yasaʿ from his father, from Khālid ibn al-Walīd. Al-Yasaʿ also related from ʿAṭāʾ ibn Abī Rabāḥ, Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, and others. Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī said of him: “He is not strong.” Ibn Abī Ḥātim and Ibn Ḥibbān mentioned him among the trustworthy Successors.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بالتصغير بن العنبس الأنصاري استدركه بن الأثير فوهم وانما هو بالنون وقد تقدم على الصواب
records.english: In the diminutive form, son of al-ʿAnbas, al-Anṣārī. Ibn al-Athīr added him and erred. His name is in fact written with nūn, and it appeared earlier in the correct form.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الأنصاري أخرج البيهقي في الشعب من طريق محمد بن إسحاق البلخي عن عمرو بن قيس عن أبيه عن جده عن خالد أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال أحرم الأحمق ثم نقل البيهقي عن شيخه الحاكم أن اسم جد قيس يسير بن يزيد الأنصاري وأن أسانيده عزيزة وأنكر البيهقي على شيخه ذلك وقال ليس في الصحابة أحد اسمه يسير بن يزيد وانما هو يسير بن عمرو تابعي مخضرم ثم أخرج الحديث المذكور من طريق يعقوب بن سفيان عن أبي سعيد الأشج عن عمرو بن قيس به ولم يرفعه وقال الموقوف أصح انتهى وقد تقدم يسير بن عمرو في القسم الثالث وقد تبدل أوله همزة ومضت الإشارة إلى ذلك في حرف الألف
records.english: al-Anṣārī. Al-Bayhaqī transmitted in al-Shuʿab, through Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq al-Balkhī, from ʿAmr ibn Qays, from his father, from his grandfather, from Khālid, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Aḥrama al-aḥmaq,” an unvocalized maxim whose verb remains unresolved. Al-Bayhaqī then reported from his teacher al-Ḥākim that the name of Qays’s grandfather was Yusayr ibn Yazīd al-Anṣārī and that his chains were rare. Al-Bayhaqī rejected this claim by his teacher and said: “There is no Companion named Yusayr ibn Yazīd. Rather, he is Yusayr ibn ʿAmr, a Successor who lived across the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods.” He then transmitted the cited report through Yaʿqūb ibn Sufyān, from Abū Saʿīd al-Ashajj, from ʿAmr ibn Qays by the same chain, without raising it to the Prophet, and said: “The stopped version is sounder.” End of quotation. Yusayr ibn ʿAmr appeared earlier in the third division. His first letter is also given as a hamzah, as noted earlier under the letter alif.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الثقفي تابعي معروف قيل اسمه عقبة ذكره بن أبي خيثمة في الصحابة وهو وهم قال البغوي حدثنا أبو حيثمة حدثنا بن علية عن خالد الحذاء عن القاسم بن ربيعة عن يعقوب بن أوس رجل من الصحابة أو عن رجل من الصحابة رفعه في دية شبه العمد قال البغوي هكذا عندنا عن أبي خيثمة بالشك وحدثناه أحمد بن أبي خيثمة عن أبيه لم يقل أو عن رجل من الصحابة قلت قال بن أبي خيثمة بعد تخريجه ليست ليعقوب صحبة وانما رواه عن عبد الله بن عمرو والحديث عند أبي داود من رواية حماد بن يزيد ووهيب بن خالد كلاهما عن خالد الحذاء عن القاسم بن ربيعة عن عقبة بن أوس عن عبد الله بن عمرو قال خطب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم الفتح فذكر حديثا وفيه فقال ألا ان دية الخطأ شبه العمد ما كان بالسوط والعصا مائة من الإبل منها أربعون في بطونها أولادها وأخرجه النسائي من طريق حماد بن زيد فقال عن عقبة بن أوس عن رجل من الصحابة ومن طريق بن أبي عدي عن خالد عن القاسم عن عقبة بن أوس أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال فذكره مرسلا من طريق بشر بن المفضل ويزيد بن زريع كلاهما عن خالد مثل رواية وهيب لكن لم يسم الصحابي وسمى شيخ القاسم يعقوب وذكر أبو داود فيه اختلافا آخر على القاسم بن ربيعة هل هو عبد الله بن عمرو أو بن عمر إذ ليس بين القاسم وبينه أحد
records.english: al-Thaqafī. He was a well-known Successor; it is said that his name was ʿUqbah. Ibn Abī Khaythamah mentioned him among the Companions, which was an error. Al-Baghawī said: Abū Khaythamah narrated to us; Ibn ʿUlayyah narrated to us, from Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, from al-Qāsim ibn Rabīʿah, from Yaʿqūb ibn Aws, “a man among the Companions”—or “from a man among the Companions”—raising a report concerning the blood money for quasi-intentional killing. Al-Baghawī said: “This is how we have it from Abū Khaythamah, with uncertainty. Aḥmad ibn Abī Khaythamah related it to us from his father without saying, ‘or from a man among the Companions.’” I say: After transmitting it, Ibn Abī Khaythamah said: “Yaʿqūb had no companionship. He related it only from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr.” In Abū Dāwūd, the report comes through Ḥammād ibn Zayd and Wuhayb ibn Khālid, both from Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, from al-Qāsim ibn Rabīʿah, from ʿUqbah ibn Aws, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, who said: “The Prophet ﷺ delivered a sermon on the day of the Conquest,” and then related a hadith containing: “Indeed, the blood money for an accidental killing resembling an intentional one—committed with a whip or stick—is one hundred camels, forty of them carrying young in their wombs.” Al-Nasāʾī transmitted it through Ḥammād ibn Zayd as “from ʿUqbah ibn Aws, from a man among the Companions,” and through Ibn Abī ʿAdī from Khālid, from al-Qāsim, from ʿUqbah ibn Aws, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said it, thus transmitting it without a connected chain. Through Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal and Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ, both from Khālid, he transmitted it like Wuhayb’s version but did not name the Companion and called al-Qāsim’s teacher Yaʿqūb. Abū Dāwūd mentioned another disagreement concerning al-Qāsim ibn Rabīʿah: whether the narrator was ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr or Ibn ʿUmar, with no one between al-Qāsim and him.

records.arabic: الثقفي حليف بني زهرة استشهد باليمامة كذا وقع في التجريد وهو وهم صحف اسم أبيه وانما هو بن جارية بالجيم وقد تقدم
records.english: al-Thaqafī. He was an ally of Banū Zuhrah. He was martyred at al-Yamāmah. This is how the name appears in al-Tajrīd, but it is an error caused by corruption of his father’s name. He is in fact Ibn Jāriyah, with jīm, and appeared earlier.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن أمية استدركه بن فتحون وعزاه ليحيى بن سعيد الأموي في المغازي قال أنبأنا يزيد بن أبي زياد عن مجاهد قال جاء يعلى بن صفوان بن أمية بابنه إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد فتح مكة ليبايعه على الهجرة وهكذا أخرجه بن قانع من طريق يزيد بن أبي زياد وهو مقلوب وهم فيه بعض رواته والصواب عن مجاهد عن صفوان بن يعلى بن أمية أن يعلى جاء بابنه نبه عليه بن فتحون وصفوان بن يعلى بن أمية تابعي معروف
records.english: son of Umayyah. Ibn Fatḥūn added him and attributed the report to Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Umawī in al-Maghāzī, who said: Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād informed us, from Mujāhid, who said: “After the conquest of Mecca, Yaʿlā ibn Ṣafwān ibn Umayyah brought his son to the Messenger of God ﷺ so that he might pledge allegiance to emigrate.” Ibn Qāniʿ likewise transmitted it through Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād. The name order is reversed; one of its transmitters erred. The correct version is from Mujāhid, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaʿlā ibn Umayyah, that Yaʿlā brought his son. Ibn Fatḥūn pointed this out. Ṣafwān ibn Yaʿlā ibn Umayyah was a well-known Successor.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن قانع وهو وهم وانما هو علي بن طلق فان بن قانع أخرج بسند له عن جعفر بن عوف عن يحيى بن سعيد عن محمد بن المنكدر عن يعلى بن طلق رفعه ان الرجل ليصلي وما فاته من وقتها أفضل من أهله وماله
records.english: Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him. However, this is an error; he is ʿAlī ibn Ṭalq. Ibn Qāniʿ transmitted with his chain from Jaʿfar ibn ʿAwf, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Yaʿlā ibn Ṭalq, raising it to the Prophet: “A man may perform the prayer, while what he missed of its appointed time is better than his family and his wealth.”

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: غير منسوب ذكره بن قانع وأخرج من طريق الوليد بن مسلم عن سفيان عن عمرو بن يعلى عن أبيه قال أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وفي يدي خاتم من ذهب فقال أتؤدي زكاة هذا قلت أفيه زكاة يا رسول الله قال جمرة غليظة قلت يعلى هذا هو بن مرة كما جزم به الطبراني لما أخرج هذا الحديث والصواب أن الراوي عنه عمر بضم العين وهو منسوب لجده فإنه عمر بن عبد الله بن يعلى بن مرة مشهور له أحاديث عن أبيه عن جده وقد تقدم بعض الكلام على هذا المتن في رباح الثقفي في حرف الراء
records.english: His lineage is not given. Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him and transmitted, through al-Walīd ibn Muslim, from Sufyān, from ʿAmr ibn Yaʿlā, from his father, who said: “I came to the Prophet ﷺ with a gold ring in my hand. He asked, ‘Do you pay the alms due on this?’ I replied, ‘Is alms due on it, Messenger of God?’ He said, ‘A thick ember.’” I say: This Yaʿlā is Ibn Murrah, as al-Ṭabarānī stated decisively when he transmitted this report. The correct name of the narrator from him is ʿUmar—with ḍammah on the ʿayn—and he is attributed to his grandfather. He was ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yaʿlā ibn Murrah, a well-known transmitter with hadiths from his father, from his grandfather. Part of the discussion of this text appeared earlier under Ribāḥ al-Thaqafī, under the letter rāʾ.

records.arabic: غير منسوب آخر رواه بن فتحون في الذيل وعزاه لتخريج يحيى بن يحيى التميمي عن عمرو بن عثمان عن أبيه عن يعلى أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم انتهى إلى مضيق هو وأصحابه فتقدم فصلى بهم على راحلته يومي إيماء السجود أخفض من الركوع قلت ويعلى هذا أيضا بن مرة وقد أخرجه الترمذي من طريق شبابة بن سوار عن عمر بن الرماح عن كعب بن زياد عن عمر بن عثمان بن يعلى بن مرة عن أبيه عن جده فذكر الحديث وقال غريب تفرد به عمر بن الرماح وأخرجه الدارقطني من طريق محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن غزوان عن بن الرماح بهذا السند فقال يعلى بن أمية ورجح شيخنا في شرح الترمذي رواية شبابة وعلى كل تقدير فيعلى هذا ليس آخر
records.english: Another man whose lineage is not given. Ibn Fatḥūn related him in the supplement and attributed the report to the transmission of Yaḥyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Tamīmī, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from his father, from Yaʿlā: the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions reached a narrow pass. He went forward and led them in prayer while mounted, gesturing with his head, making the gesture for prostration lower than that for bowing. I say: This Yaʿlā is also Ibn Murrah. Al-Tirmidhī transmitted the report through Shabābah ibn Sawwār, from ʿUmar ibn al-Rammāḥ, from Kaʿb ibn Ziyād, from ʿUmar ibn ʿUthmān ibn Yaʿlā ibn Murrah, from his father, from his grandfather. He recounted the report and said: “It is uncommon; ʿUmar ibn al-Rammāḥ alone transmitted it.” Al-Dāraquṭnī transmitted it through Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ghazwān, from Ibn al-Rammāḥ, with this chain, but said “Yaʿlā ibn Umayyah.” Our teacher, in his commentary on al-Tirmidhī, preferred Shabābah’s version. On either account, this Yaʿlā is not another man.

records.arabic: ذكره بن قانع وأخرج من طريق محمد بن معاوية الهلالي عن خالد بن عمرو الأموي عن يوسف بن سهل الأنصاري عن أبيه عن جده قال صعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم المنبر فقال يا أيها الناس ان أبا بكر لم يسؤني قط فاعرفوا له ذلك الحديث قال شيخ شيوخنا العلائي هذا وهم والصواب عن سهل بن يوسف بن سهل عن أبيه عن جده واسم جده سهل بن حنيف وقد رواه بن قانع في وضع آخر من طريق محمد بن يونس عن خالد بن عمرو على الصواب قال العلائي وهذا أشبه قلت وأخرجه بن عساكر من طريق محمد بن أحمد بن عمرو اللؤلؤي عن علي بن عبد الحميد عن محمد بن معاوية النيسابوري وهو الهلالي كما تقدم ورواه زكريا بن يحيى عن سليمان بن داود عن خالد بن عمر عن سهل بن يوسف بن سهل بن مالك عن أبيه عن جده كذلك رواه الزعفراني عن زكريا ووقع لنا في الخلعيات من طريق أبي سعيد بن الأعرابي عن الزعفراني
records.english: Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him. He transmitted, through Muḥammad ibn Muʿāwiyah al-Hilālī, from Khālid ibn ʿAmr al-Umawī, from Yūsuf ibn Sahl al-Anṣārī, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ ascended the pulpit and said, ‘People, Abū Bakr has never displeased me, so recognize that merit of his.’” This is the report. Al-ʿAlāʾī, the teacher of our teachers, said: “This is an error. The correct chain is from Sahl ibn Yūsuf ibn Sahl, from his father, from his grandfather; his grandfather’s name was Sahl ibn Ḥunayf.” Ibn Qāniʿ transmitted it correctly elsewhere through Muḥammad ibn Yūnus, from Khālid ibn ʿAmr. Al-ʿAlāʾī said: “This is more likely.” I say: Ibn ʿAsākir transmitted it through Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAmr al-Luʾluʾī, from ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from Muḥammad ibn Muʿāwiyah al-Naysābūrī—who is al-Hilālī, as stated earlier. Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā related it from Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd, from Khālid ibn ʿAmr, from Sahl ibn Yūsuf ibn Sahl ibn Mālik, from his father, from his grandfather. Al-Zaʿfarānī likewise related it from Zakariyyā. It reached us in al-Khulaʿiyyāt through Abū Saʿīd ibn al-Aʿrābī, from al-Zaʿfarānī.
